```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script fits linear mixed-effects models of the ARF and CALF scores on modality and task. It saves:

1. The combined model (modality x task) and the models for each task, controlling for grade and device (Table 6; Table S9.8).
2. The four pre-registered models, controlling for grade and, in models 3 and 4, the RT control score (Table S6; cleaned scores only).

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lme4)        # lmer
library(lmerTest)    # p-values for the fixed effects
library(performance) # icc, r2
```

# Paths and settings

```{r}
# "cleaned" for the fully cleaned scores, "no_cleaning" for the uncleaned scores
version <- "cleaned"

scores_dir <- here("data", "scores")

# Each version: its scores file, where its results go, and the table names
versions <- list(
  cleaned     = list(scores_file = "scores_combined_rt-3-75_5-875-7917_math.csv",
                     results_dir = here("results"),
                     task_models_file = "table6_regression_task_models.csv",
                     preregistered_file = "sup6_table1_regression_preregistered.csv"),
  no_cleaning = list(scores_file = "scores_combined_no_cleaning.csv",
                     results_dir = here("results", "no_cleaning"),
                     task_models_file = "sup9_table8_regression_task_models.csv",
                     preregistered_file = NULL)
)

results_dir <- versions[[version]]$results_dir
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sub_data <- read.csv(file.path(scores_dir, versions[[version]]$scores_file))
```

# Model results table

```{r}
term_labels <- c("(Intercept)" = "Intercept",
                 "Grade" = "Grade",
                 "devicemobile" = "Device [tablet]",
                 "taskARF" = "Task [ARF]",
                 "modalityFC" = "Modality [FC]",
                 "modalityFC:taskARF" = "Modality [FC] x Task [ARF]",
                 "RT_Control_Score" = "RT Control",
                 "ID" = "Between Participant",
                 "Residual" = "Within Participant")

model_column <- function(mod, model_name) {
  coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(mod)$coefficients)
  stars <- as.character(cut(coefs[["Pr(>|t|)"]], breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
                            labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "")))
  fixed <- tibble(term = rownames(coefs), value = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", coefs$Estimate), stars))

  random <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod)) %>%
    transmute(term = grp, value = sprintf("%.2f", vcov))

  stats <- tibble(term = c("ICC (adjusted)", "Conditional R2", "Number of participants"),
                  value = c(sprintf("%.2f", performance::icc(mod)$ICC_adjusted),
                            sprintf("%.2f", performance::r2(mod)$R2_conditional),
                            as.character(ngrps(mod)[["ID"]])))

  bind_rows(fixed, random, stats) %>%
    mutate(term = recode(term, !!!term_labels)) %>%
    rename(!!model_name := value)
}

results_table <- function(models) {
  imap(models, model_column) %>%
    reduce(full_join, by = "term") %>%
    mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c(term_labels, "ICC (adjusted)", "Conditional R2", "Number of participants"))) %>%
    arrange(term) %>%
    mutate(term = as.character(term)) %>%
    add_row(term = "Fixed Effects (b)", .before = 1) %>%
    add_row(term = "Random Effects (Variance)", .before = which(.$term == "Between Participant")) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, "")))
}
```

# Table 6: Modality and task models, controlling for grade and device

```{r}
lm_data <- sub_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc, user_grade_at_run, device) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc), names_to = "condition", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(task = factor(ifelse(grepl("arf", condition), "ARF", "CALF"), levels = c("CALF", "ARF")),
         modality = factor(ifelse(grepl("prod", condition), "FR", "FC"), levels = c("FR", "FC")),
         Grade = as.integer(case_when(user_grade_at_run == "Kindergarten" ~ "0", .default = user_grade_at_run)),
         Grade = Grade - min(Grade))

m_task <- lmer(score ~ modality*task + Grade + device + (1|ID), data = lm_data)
m_arf <- lmer(score ~ modality + Grade + device + (1|ID), data = lm_data %>% filter(task == "ARF"))
m_calf <- lmer(score ~ modality + Grade + device + (1|ID), data = lm_data %>% filter(task == "CALF"))

table6 <- results_table(list(combined_model = m_task, arf_model = m_arf, calf_model = m_calf))

table6

write.csv(table6, file.path(results_dir, versions[[version]]$task_models_file), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Table S6: Pre-registered models

```{r}
if (!is.null(versions[[version]]$preregistered_file)) {
  lm_data_rt <- sub_data %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc,
                  rtControl_score_production, rtControl_score_6afc, rtControl_score_2afc, user_grade_at_run, device) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc), names_to = "condition", values_to = "score") %>%
    mutate(RT_Control_Score = case_when(condition %in% c("arf_prod", "calf_prod") ~ rtControl_score_production,
                                        condition == "arf_2afc" ~ rtControl_score_2afc,
                                        condition == "calf_6afc" ~ rtControl_score_6afc),
           RT_Control_Score = RT_Control_Score - mean(RT_Control_Score),
           task = factor(ifelse(grepl("arf", condition), "ARF", "CALF"), levels = c("CALF", "ARF")),
           modality = factor(ifelse(grepl("prod", condition), "FR", "FC"), levels = c("FR", "FC")),
           Grade = as.integer(case_when(user_grade_at_run == "Kindergarten" ~ "0", .default = user_grade_at_run)),
           Grade = Grade - min(Grade))

  m1 <- lmer(score ~ task + Grade + (1|ID), data = lm_data_rt)
  m2 <- lmer(score ~ modality*task + Grade + (1|ID), data = lm_data_rt)
  m3 <- lmer(score ~ task + Grade + RT_Control_Score + (1|ID), data = lm_data_rt)
  m4 <- lmer(score ~ modality*task + Grade + RT_Control_Score + (1|ID), data = lm_data_rt)

  tableS6 <- results_table(list(model_1 = m1, model_2 = m2, model_3 = m3, model_4 = m4))

  print(tableS6)

  write.csv(tableS6, file.path(results_dir, versions[[version]]$preregistered_file), row.names = FALSE)
}
```
